ModMetaData.name: Ancient Mining Industry (HSK Patched)
ModMetaData.description:
All-in-one HSK-balanced fork of Ancient Mining Industry by Bread MO + AobaKuma.
Player-craftable buildings (drilling rig, tunnel boring machine, ore dressing machine, conveyors, structural supports, mini turrets) are rebalanced to match HSK's true canonical building pattern from Core_SK/Defs/ThingDefs_Buildings/Buildings_Production_Hightech.xml — same as native HSK DeepDrill / Hemopump / etc.:
- stuffCategories RuggedMetallic + costStuffCount (player picks SteelBar / Plasteel / etc., gets stuff variation on the visual) - HSK component pipeline (ComponentIndustrial / ElectronicComponents / Mechanism / ComponentSpacer for top tier) - Turret barrel-fuel filter swapped from raw Steel to SteelBar so reload jobs use a normal HSK haulable resource
Ancient (loot/spawn) variants left untouched — Pacas Patches Compilation already covers those with HSK refined materials. This fork picks up where Pacas left off and uses the canonical stuffCategories pattern HSK uses for its own buildings.
Drop-in replacement — incompatibleWith upstream so they can't double-load. Switch back to upstream Workshop version when not playing HSK.
Credits to Bread MO + AobaKuma for the original mod, and Pacas for the Ancient* loot patches it complements.
